head: codex/47-exact-rust-test-selectors
title: [C-SDLC v2][validation] Make named Rust test selectors target only their declared lane
body:
Closes #47

Makes Rust test lane selection fail closed when a free substring could fan out across unrelated targets. Distinguishes exact singular targets from intentional broad target sets, supports documented Cargo toolchain/global/alias/value-option syntax, and rejects ambiguous or conflicting selector shapes before execution.

Validation: focused selector guard 1/1; selector integration 2/2; exact schema lane 3/3; strict all-target Clippy; formatting; typed issue validation generation 22; exact-head subagent review with all findings fixed and no remaining P0-P3 findings.
